headline: Today now opens with a header: the date and time, a greeting from your AI, and a box that opens a chat with your question typed in. The calendar lists today's meetings with a Now line, each with one status line and at most one button. To do opens on Focus, the items you are working on, with All open and search one press away. A meeting whose title names someone off limits now offers nothing anywhere on the Hub. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
